briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Market Tops $17B as D.C. Inches Toward Schedule III
briefs.top: Michigan's legal cannabis market just crossed $17 billion in lifetime sales and a new Ann Arbor storefront is opening even as the 24% wholesale tax fight heats up in the governor's race. Nationally, DEA's rescheduling transcript is public and Judge Julius's recommendation is expected any day, while FDA's psychedelic hearing and Compass Pathways' COMP360 progress keep momentum building toward 2027 approvals.

local.text: Michigan crosses $17 billion in lifetime sales — August alone generated roughly $259 million, pushing combined adult-use and medical sales past the milestone since legalization began.
Lume opens new Ann Arbor storefront — the Michigan-based chain's West Liberty Street location held a three-day grand opening with extended hours.
Governor hopeful pledges to kill the wholesale tax — Rep. John James, now backed by industry donors who wrote roughly $90,000 in checks, has promised to repeal the 24% levy if elected.
Sales stabilize after tax shock, pointing to a floor — after a rough January, monthly revenue climbed back to $255.4 million by March and held near $253.5 million through June.

Regulators shut down Muha Meds maker, open shelf space — the CRA revoked Michigan Investment 10's licenses and imposed a record $2 million fine after finding a surveillance camera pointed at a wall instead of the extraction room.

national.text: DEA publishes rescheduling transcript, decision nears — the 2,533-page record of 11 days of testimony is now public as Judge Derek Julius weighs a Schedule III recommendation.
Trump commutes federal marijuana sentences — the White House cut short a 30-year and a 10-year sentence, adding to a string of cannabis clemency actions.

FDA holds landmark hearing on psychedelic medicine — the White Oak session gathered feedback on provider training, patient safety and access as part of implementing the administration's order to speed psychedelic drug review.

Compass Pathways closes in on psilocybin filing — COMP360 showed six-month durability in treatment-resistant depression, with a completed NDA submission targeted for Q4 2026 and launch eyed for early 2027.
MSO consolidation keeps rolling with Vireo-Planet 13 tie-up — Vireo Growth signed a merger agreement for Planet 13 Holdings, adding to a wave of deals reshaping the multistate operator landscape.
